title: "This is Me"
coreMove: Check whether your help comes from a real, examined presence instead of a role performance.
sourcePressure: Rogers opens by placing the therapist as a real person before any theory, so later claims read as lived conviction rather than doctrine. Frozen sidecar ch01 supports the heading, part placement, and broad thematic claims; it exposes no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating the opening as autobiography or generic authenticity advice.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of Speaking Personally
counterintuition: Most people think X, but Y
It is not about being nice
The paradox is that acceptance changes everything
